statement: ∀ (U : Set (YuiEucl n)) (d a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ d → Metric.ediam U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal d → b - a ≤ d → Metric.ediam {z : YuiEucl (n+1) | YuiHead z ∈ U ∧ YuiLast z ∈ Set.Icc a b} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2 * d)
proof:
intro U d a b hd hU hab
apply Metric.ediam_le_of_forall_dist_le
intro z hz w hw
have hdist : dist (YuiHead z) (YuiHead w) ≤ d := by
  have h := Metric.edist_le_ediam_of_mem hz.1 hw.1
  rw [edist_dist] at h
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hd).mp (h.trans hU)
have hlast : |YuiLast z - YuiLast w| ≤ d := by
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith [hz.2.1, hz.2.2, hw.2.1, hw.2.2]
have hformula : dist z w = Real.sqrt ((dist (YuiHead z) (YuiHead w))^2 + |YuiLast z - YuiLast w|^2) := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← (h_T003 n).2.1 z, ← (h_T003 n).2.1 w]
  exact (h_T003 n).2.2.1 _ _ _ _
rw [hformula]
apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).mpr
constructor
· positivity
· have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  have hsq1 : (dist (YuiHead z) (YuiHead w))^2 ≤ d^2 := by nlinarith [dist_nonneg (YuiHead z) (YuiHead w)]
  have hsq2 : |YuiLast z - YuiLast w|^2 ≤ d^2 := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (YuiLast z - YuiLast w)]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt 2 * d)]
